what: perufauna: Easily Load and Harmonize Peruvian Fauna and Biodiversity Packages
title: perufauna: Easily Load and Harmonize Peruvian Fauna and Biodiversity Packages
text: perufauna es un metapaquete que orquesta y armoniza el ecosistema de paquetes de biodiversidad y fauna del Perú: avesperu: Lista patrón oficial de aves del Perú (Checklist UNOP). perumammals: Backbone taxonómico y validación de mamíferos del Perú (Pacheco et al. 2021). citesperu: Estatus y verificación en los Apéndices CITES del Perú (MINAM). perufaunads004: Fauna amenazada nacional (D.S. N° 004-2014-MINAGRI y Libro Rojo de SERFOR).

N° 004-2014-MINAGRI SERFOR Red Book. addition orchestrated attachment, perufauna provides integrated cross-referencing functions pf_match pf_status analyze species across taxonomic regulatory sources single call.

what: Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
title: Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
text: Integrates cross-references scientific names across four specialized Peruvian biodiversity databases: avesperu: UNOP Bird Checklist Peru. perumammals: Pacheco et al. (2021) Peru Mammals Checklist. citesperu: MINAM Official CITES Appendices Peru. perufaunads004: D.S. . 004-2014-MINAGRI & SERFOR Threatened Fauna Red Book.

title: Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
text: splist Character vector scientific names validate, data.frame containing column species names. max_distance Numeric. Maximum string distance allowed fuzzy matching (default: 0.1). ... Additional arguments passed underlying matching engines.

title: Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
text: tibble::tibble harmonized cross-database columns: submitted_name: raw input name. accepted_name: Validated/accepted scientific binomial name. taxonomic_group: Taxonomic class/group ("Aves", "Mammalia", "Reptilia", "Amphibia", etc.). in_peru: Logical. Confirmed presence Peru via UNOP, Pacheco, D.S. 004. in_unop: Character. UNOP bird status ("Residente", "Endémico", "Divagante", "Migratorio", "Introducido", "confirmado", NA). in_pacheco: Logical. Listed Pacheco et al. (2021) Peru Mammals. cites_appendix: CITES status ("", "II", "III", NA). ds004_category: National threat category ("CR", "EN", "VU", "NT", NA). is_threatened: Logical. Listed national threat (D.S. 004 Libro Rojo). is_endemic: Logical. Endemic Peru (based UNOP Pacheco).

title: Cross-Referenced Taxonomic and Conservation Matching for Peruvian Fauna — pf_match
code: # \donttest{ species <- c("Panthera onca", "Vultur gryphus", "Tremarctos ornatus", "Homo sapiens") pf_match(species) #> # A tibble: 4 × 10 #>   submitted_name     accepted_name    taxonomic_group in_peru in_unop in_pacheco #>   <chr>              <chr>            <chr>           <lgl>   <chr>   <lgl>      #> 1 Panthera onca      Panthera onca    Mammalia        TRUE    NA      TRUE       #> 2 Vultur gryphus     Vultur gryphus   Aves            TRUE    Reside… FALSE      #> 3 Tremarctos ornatus Tremarctos orna… Mammalia        TRUE    NA      TRUE       #> 4 Homo sapiens       Homo sapiens     NA              FALSE   NA      FALSE      #> # ℹ 4 more variables: cites_appendix <chr>, ds004_category <chr>, #> #   is_threatened <lgl>, is_endemic <lgl> # }

title: perufauna (development version)
text: avesperu: UNOP Bird Checklist Peru, reporting qualitative status ("Residente", "Endémico", "Divagante", "Migratorio", etc.). perumammals: Pacheco et al. (2021) Peru Mammals Checklist. citesperu: MINAM Official CITES Appendices Peru. perufaunads004: D.S. . 004-2014-MINAGRI & SERFOR Threatened Fauna Red Book. pf_status(): Structured, reproducible tibble summarizing taxonomic group, occurrence/residency status, CITES appendix, D.S. 004 threat status. perufauna_attach(): Attach ecosystem packages clean startup messages. perufauna_conflicts(): S3 conflict detection comparing memory pointers. perufauna_sitrep(): Situation report runtime diagnostics. perufauna_deps(): Ecosystem dependency installation version overview. perufauna_packages(): Return names core packages. perufauna_logo(): Render ASCII banner.
